paragraphs: Badger Meter makes flow measurement, water quality and control products for water utilities, municipalities, and commercial and industrial customers worldwide. The company groups these under a brand it calls BlueEdge, presented as custom solutions for water management.

Among the water quality instruments listed is a multi-parameter water quality monitor. Software listed for utilities includes a utility platform and a consumer engagement app for water use. The company describes end-to-end solutions for flow measurement and water quality monitoring drawn from over a century of experience. It says its smart water offerings combine measurement, communication and data so customers can better manage water resources.

The site claims over 120 years of proven technology behind the business. Badger Meter says it acquired UDlive, a UK-based provider of hardware-enabled software for sewer line monitoring. It states that ORION Cellular passes security and reliability tests. A 2025 sustainability report is posted on the site.

quote.text: With over a century of experience, we offer end-to-end solutions for flow measurement, water quality monitoring and more.
